renderedBlocks.title: 1. Breadth-First Search (BFS) Fundamentals
renderedBlocks.content: Breadth-first search is a fundamental graph traversal algorithm that systematically explores edges to discover every vertex reachable from a starting source vertex s.

renderedBlocks.title: 2. BFS Mechanism and Data Structure
renderedBlocks.content: The algorithm uses a First-In, First-Out (FIFO) queue to manage discovered vertices and computes the shortest path distance measured in number of edges.

renderedBlocks.title: 3. Time Complexity Analysis
renderedBlocks.content: The running time of breadth-first search is O(V + E), where V represents the number of vertices and E represents the number of edges in the graph.

renderedBlocks.title: 4. Identified Study Gaps
renderedBlocks.content: Current understanding requires clarification on why a FIFO queue is strictly required for level-order traversal and the exact mechanics of exploring neighbors before deeper vertices.

Algorithms and Data Structures Reference Manual
Chapter 1: Graph Algorithms and Breadth-First Search
1.1 Breadth-First Search (BFS)
Breadth-first search is a fundamental graph traversal algorithm. It systematically explores the edges of a
graph to discover every vertex reachable from a starting source vertex s.
BFS uses a First-In, First-Out (FIFO) queue to manage discovered vertices. The algorithm computes the
shortest path distance (measured in number of edges) from the source to each reachable vertex.
The running time of breadth-first search is O(V + E), where V is the number of vertices and E is the number of
edges in the graph.

Data Structures & Algorithms: Graph Traversal
Topic: Breadth-First Search (BFS)
1. Basic Concept & Properties
- BFS visits nodes level by level starting from source.
- It uses a queue data structure to track discovery order.
- Need to mark visited vertices to avoid infinite loops.
2. Study Gaps & Questions to Understand:
- Why is a FIFO queue strictly required for level-order?
- How does BFS explore neighbors before deeper vertices?
- What is the exact time complexity in terms of V and E?
